mz_curves.csv.description: impurity occupations and magnetization from the polarized start (IC 10), t <= 20, every 5th output frame (driver: plus the frame at t')

steady.csv.description: one row per run: steady state (driver: frame at t'; exact IC 00: NESS; exact IC 11/10: state at t = 150) and trajectory record

columns.ss_detected: 1 if t' was detected (0: detector timeout)
columns.P_min: min over checkpoints (driver, every 2) or frames (exact, every 1) of the smallest eigenvalue of P [1]
columns.Mz_t1e: IC 10: first time at which Mz(t) = Mz(0)/e [1/h1]
columns.Mz_last005: IC 10: last time at which Mz(t) = 0.05 is crossed from above, linear interpolation between frames (end of the series if it ends above 0.05; driver: up to the end of the run; exact: t <= 150) [1/h1]
